Method of Attack: Exploits a DOM Based XSS vulnerability in the local macOS HTML file rhtmlPlayer.html to execute arbitrary JavaScript code, bypassing macOS file quarantine restrictions.
Impacted Systems: macOS versions 10.10, 10.11, 10.12, and probably prior versions
Attack Vector: Malicious .webloc file that loads local rhtmlPlayer.html and executes attacker JavaScript code
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .webloc file exploiting rhtmlPlayer.html DOM Based XSS vulnerability
